description: This script generates license checksum entries for Chromium projects, utilizing Chromium's own license parsing tools to scan third-party directories and produce a license list for Yocto recipes.

methods.name: find_chromium_licenses
methods.description: Scans a Chromium checkout directory for license files of used third-party components and returns a set of license file paths.

methods.name: print_license_list
methods.description: Generates a license checksum list for Chromium license files suitable for inclusion in a Yocto recipe.
